_status: DRAFT for Koushik review. 65 category names exactly as used by the 228 frozen records of 24.10.2026 + 1 new (surveying_geodesy, approved 26.10.2026). No renames.
_aggregation_method: UNION of unique course-instance credits (a course counts once in a sum or item)
_classification_rule: A course may carry several categories. The same-subject rules below are applied after classification, before any counting.

_same_subject_rules.rule: Technische Mechanik: statics, strength of materials, kinematics, dynamics. The civil and the mechanical name mean the same subject. A course classified as one is ALWAYS also classified as the other; it is counted once in every item and sum (R17 C4 / union of course credits).
Fluid mechanics / hydromechanics. The civil and the mechanical name mean the same subject. A course classified as one is ALWAYS also classified as the other; counted once.

computer_engineering keeps its record meaning (hardware + networks + distributed systems). A course classified as computer_networks is ALWAYS also classified as computer_engineering; counted once. A distributed / cloud / parallel computing course is classified as computer_engineering.

_kept_broad_on_purpose: calculus_analysis keeps "numerical methods" (old meaning); a numerics course is also optimization_numerics
general_physics keeps engineering-mechanics topics (old meaning); an Engineering Mechanics course is also general_physics
structural_mechanics / mechanics_dynamics keep structural analysis and FEM (old meaning); a Structural Analysis course is also structural_engineering
Narrowing any of these waits for the before/after check (Koushik 26.10.2026)
